library(rvest)

## strings and regex

```{r}
string_vec = c("my", "name", "is", "jeff")

str_detect(string_vec, "jeff") #basically command F with more control
str_detect(string_vec, "My")
str_detect(string_vec, "my")

str_replace(string_vec, "my", "My")
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  "i think we all rule for participating",
  "i think i have been caught",
  "i think this will be quite fun actually",
  "it will be fun, i think"
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "i think")
str_detect(string_vec, "^i think")
str_detect(string_vec, "i think$")
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  "Time for a Pumpkin Spice Latte!",
  "went to the #pumpkinpatch last weekend",
  "Pumpkin Pie is obviously the best pie",
  "SMASHING PUMPKINS -- LIVE IN CONCERT!!"
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "[Pp]umpkin") #either capital or lowercase is true
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  '7th inning stretch',
  '1st half soon to begin. Texas won the toss.',
  'she is 5 feet 4 inches tall',
  '3AM - cant sleep :('
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "[0-9][a-zA-Z]")
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  'Its 7:11 in the evening',
  'want to go to 7-11?',
  'my flight is AA711',
  'NetBios: scanning ip 203.167.114.66'
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "7.11")
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  'The CI is [2, 5]',
  ':-]',
  ':-[',
  'I found the answer on pages [6-7]'
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "\\[") #if you want to look for the bracket itself, use  \\
```

## quick note on factors

```{r}
vec_sex = factor(c("male", "male", "female", "female"))

as.numeric(vec_sex) #places it into its levels

vec_sex = fct_relevel(vec_sex, "male") #releveling categories

as.numeric(vec_sex)
```


##Import NSDUH

```{r}
url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"

drug_use_html = 
  read_html(url)
```

Cleaning the tables

```{r}
marj_df = 
  drug_use_html |> 
  html_table() |> #gets all tables in html
  first() |> #takes first table
  slice(-1) |>  #removes rows not wanted
  select(-contains("P Value")) |> #Everything that DOESNT have P Value
  pivot_longer(
    -State, #everything BUT state
    names_to = "age_year",
    values_to = "prev"
  ) |> 
  separate(age_year, into = c("age", "year"), sep = "\\(") |> #splits column to two 
  mutate(
    year = str_replace(year, "\\)", ""), #removes character from values
    prev = str_replace(prev, "[a-c]", ""), #removes character from values
    prev = as.numeric(prev)
  )
```



make a quick plot

```{r}
marj_df |> 
  filter(age =="12-17") |> 
  mutate(State = fct_reorder(State, prev)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=State, y = prev, color = year)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```


## NYC Airbnb

```{r}
data("nyc_airbnb")

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(
    neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan",
    price < 1000) |> 
  mutate(neighbourhood = fct_reorder(neighbourhood, price)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = neighbourhood, y = price)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  coord_flip() #changes x and y axis
```


## Restaurant inspections

```{r}
data("rest_inspec")

rest_inspec = 
  rest_inspec |> 
  rename(borough = boro)
```

Quick EDA

```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade,
    values_from = n
  )
```


```{r}
rest_inspec =
  rest_inspec |> 
  filter(
    borough != "0",
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C")
  )

rest_inspec |> 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade,
    values_from = n
  )
```


Look for pizza places

```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  filter(str_detect(dba, "Pizza")) |> 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade,
    values_from = n
  )


rest_inspec |> 
  filter(str_detect(dba, "[Pp][Ii][Zz][Zz][Aa]")) |> 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade,
    values_from = n
  )
```

This is better

```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  mutate(dba = str_to_upper(dba)) |> 
  filter(str_detect(dba, "PIZZA")) |> 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade,
    values_from = n
  )
```

```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  mutate(dba = str_to_upper(dba)) |> 
  filter(str_detect(dba, "PIZZA")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = borough, fill = grade)) + 
  geom_bar()
```

```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  mutate(dba = str_to_upper(dba),
         borough = fct_infreq(borough)) |> #reorders based on frequency
  filter(str_detect(dba, "PIZZA")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = borough, fill = grade)) + 
  geom_bar()
```

THis doesnt work
```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  mutate(dba = str_to_upper(dba),
         borough = fct_infreq(borough),
         borough = str_replace(borough, "Manhattan", "The City")) |>
  filter(str_detect(dba, "PIZZA")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = borough, fill = grade)) + 
  geom_bar()
```

What does work
```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  mutate(dba = str_to_upper(dba),
         borough = fct_infreq(borough),
         borough = fct_recode(borough, "The City" = "Manhattan")) |>
  filter(str_detect(dba, "PIZZA")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = borough, fill = grade)) + 
  geom_bar()
```
